extras: Author notes limited time for support.
intentEvidence: This plugin allows you to set hotkey chords (sequence of hotkeys) to activate Obsidian commands.
problem: Standard single hotkeys are insufficient for executing complex, multi-step commands or Emacs-style keybinding sequences.
summary: Hotkeys Chords allows users to configure sequences of hotkeys to trigger any available Obsidian command, enabling Emacs-like keybinding workflows.
